_help: Each product needs a name and description. For the Amazon link, use ONE of these (first one found wins):
url   -> a full link, e.g. your SiteStripe short link (https://amzn.to/xxxx). Used as-is.
asin  -> the 10-character product ID from the Amazon URL (after /dp/). Your tag is added automatically.
query -> an Amazon search phrase. Opens search results with your tag (works with no ASIN).
Optional: image (file in /public or full URL), badge, emoji, color (card background tint), button, hidden (true to skip).
